title: KummerBoundaryRawEquality as its actual comparison formula
statement: For Kummer data k and an arrow f : single(integers) → single(units)[1], KummerBoundaryRawEquality l k f is precisely f ≫ towerKummerBoundary l k [def-sfb-positive-kummer-boundary] = kummerComposite [def-sp-tower-class-finite] (ShortComplex.mk k.inclusion k.power k.zero) k.exact f. This is the actual equality, without added hypotheses or existential witnesses.
